operation_details.item: The user prefers formal legalistic wording with liability disclaimers in client presentation scripts instead of persuasive creative storytelling.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For the upcoming food brand presentation, would you like to organize the discussion around the three packaging directions, their visual distinctions, and the proposed client deliverables?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes. I want each direction described clearly, with attention to the custom visual language and the artistic rationale behind the work.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. We can structure the presentation as an overview of the objectives, followed by one section for each direction and a closing comparison of implementation considerations.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The comparison should remain precise rather than sounding like a sales pitch. The client needs to understand how the directions differ in craft, cultural inspiration, and practical application.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I can draft the talking points in a restrained format, separating observable design features from interpretive commentary and identifying any items that require client confirmation.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: For client presentation scripts, I want formal legalistic wording with liability disclaimers in every paragraph instead of persuasive creative storytelling.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I will frame each paragraph formally and include a concise disclaimer addressing the preliminary nature of the concepts, subject to client approval, production testing, and any applicable rights or regulatory review.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That approach works. Please make the language consistent across all three directions and avoid claims about performance that have not been verified.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: The draft will therefore cover the purpose, visual construction, cultural references, and anticipated packaging use for each direction, while distinguishing proposed attributes from confirmed facts.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Proceed with the talking points, including a short opening statement and a neutral closing section for the client’s decision.
